curveconfig.xsd|Currency.name: Currencies
curveconfig.xsd|Currency.reason: ORE spells the element Currency, and a currency is one of the currencies reference data holds. The rule is the element's own name, which the schema states, so every section that declares a Currency leaf takes the same catalogue.

curveconfig.xsd|DayCounter.name: Day counters
curveconfig.xsd|DayCounter.reason: ORE spells the element DayCounter, and its document states ORE's own spelling, which the reference data does not hold: the registry holds the words. The set stays text until the registry states the spelling ORE writes.

curveconfig.xsd|YieldCurveDayCounter.name: Day counters
curveconfig.xsd|YieldCurveDayCounter.reason: The yield curve names its day counter with an element of its own, and its values are the day counters reference data holds.
